description: PA derives both the zero and successor equations of the finite-history recursion graph for arbitrary arithmetic base and step formulas.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.recursion_equations_derives {n : ℕ}
  (base : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (step : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 2) ⊕ Unit)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.recursionZeroFormula
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step)
          base)) ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.recursionSuccessorFormula
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step)
          step))
